d: An avian humanoid with a crest and long beard of ash-grey feathers, featuring a sharp beak and small, intense red eyes. The build is sturdy and mature, dressed in a layered ensemble of deep brown and crimson robes with golden trim, accented by a single golden pauldrons on the left shoulder and a golden circular halo floating behind the head. The figure holds a long golden staff topped with a flaming red orb and wears black gloves. BODY COLOR: Ash-grey and white LEGS: Plantigrade, with large black avian talons.
